annotations.title: Restore a backup to a new server (spends money)

description: Creates a NEW server (same GPU model and region) from an AVAILABLE backup; the original server is not changed. Billed like a new hourly server: the first hour from credits now, then per hour. Needs canLaunch, a saved card, credits for one hour, the budget and key caps. Two steps: without confirmationToken returns the price and a token; with it, launches. Poll gpucloud_get_server for the new server. [SPENDS MONEY] (permission: servers:create) [Requires a free GPU Cloud account and MCP key]

confirmationToken.description: Token returned by the previous call without token, valid 10 minutes, single use.

name.description: Display name of the new server.
